main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check); t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return on bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the mean next-day excess return on forecast > 0 bars is above 0.
reading: The 300-bar minimum is counted on forecast > 0 bars that have a next-day return inside their window, and a shortfall is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow; the slope's t is the ordinary OLS t over every pooled bar, with the coin mean taken over all its windows' 1-bar returns.
